legal_ref: 中华人民共和国增值税法 (VAT Law of the PRC, adopted 2024-12-25) art.10(1), in force 2026-01-01 (art.38); 13% first applied by MOF/STA/GACC Announcement 2019 No.39
quote: "纳税人销售货物、加工修理修配服务、有形动产租赁服务，进口货物，除本条第二项、第四项、第五项规定外，税率为百分之十三。" (art.10(1)) — sales of goods, processing/repair services, leasing of tangible movables and imports: 13%. "本法自2026年1月1日起施行。" (art.38) — law in force 1 Jan 2026. Announcement 2019 No.39: "原适用16%税率的，税率调整为13%" ... "自2019年4月1日起执行" — 16% cut to 13% from 1 Apr 2019.
source_title: 中华人民共和国增值税法 (State Taxation Administration policy database); Announcement 2019 No.39 at https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202330/content.html

reduced_rates.scope: transport, postal, basic telecoms, construction, real-estate leasing, sale of immovables, land-use rights; agricultural products, edible oils, salt, water/heating/gas, books/newspapers, feed, fertiliser, pesticides, farm machinery (art.10(2))
exports of goods; cross-border services/intangibles specified by the State Council (art.10(4)-(5))

notes: The VAT Law replaced the Provisional Regulations on VAT from 1 Jan 2026 (art.38) without changing the 13%/9%/6% rates. Simplified method levy rate 3% (art.11) for small-scale taxpayers. Consumption tax and surcharges (urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges) are levied separately.
unverified: Any temporary preferential levy rate for small-scale taxpayers (e.g. 1%) under State Council/MOF policy after 2026-01-01 not checked
Note on consumption tax and local surcharges is general background, not from a fetched text
